case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details
title: Long Venue Address Preserved Exactly
tests: Checks that a long address survives rendering without abbreviation, dropped components, altered punctuation or illegibly small type.

exact_text.text: Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB
exact_text.read_as: Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John’s Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB

faults.what: The headline and address substitute curly apostrophes (’) for the requested straight apostrophes ('), violating the explicit exact-text and punctuation requirements.

judge.summary: The flyer is clean, legible, and correctly laid out, but its curly apostrophes violate the requested exact punctuation.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly "Printmakers' Open Studio".
must_haves.why: The headline uses a curly apostrophe rather than the supplied straight apostrophe.

must_haves.item: The date and time read exactly '9 October 2027' and '11:00–17:00'.
must_haves.why: Both are present and correctly rendered, including the time’s en dash.

must_haves.item: The entire address appears in order, with line breaks permitted.
must_haves.why: All address words appear in order, but John's is rendered as John’s, so the address is not letter-for-letter exact.

must_haves.item: The address preserves the en dash in '127–129', the period and apostrophe in "St. John's", and every comma.
must_haves.why: The en dash, period, and commas are preserved, but the apostrophe is changed to a curly form.

must_haves.item: All address text is comfortably legible and inside the canvas, with no truncation or abbreviations.
must_haves.why: The complete address is readable across four lines with ample margins.

must_haves.item: The single portrait 4:5 flyer uses black and cream and contains no extra wording.
must_haves.why: The image is a portrait 4:5 black-and-cream flyer containing only the requested wording.

title: Watercolour Cottage by a Stream
tests: Whether the output visibly follows a named illustration style while preserving the requested scene.

faults.what: The image has a photographic finish, with crisp stonework, detailed grass, and realistic water reflections, rather than the requested translucent watercolour washes and softly blended edges.

judge.summary: The square image depicts a stone cottage beside a stream with green hills behind it, but looks photographic rather than like a watercolour illustration.

must_haves.item: The image visibly resembles watercolour, with translucent washes and softly blended edges rather than a photographic or 3D-rendered finish.
must_haves.why: The scene has sharp textures and photographic lighting, without visible translucent washes or softly blended painted edges.

must_haves.item: A little stone cottage is a clearly recognizable subject.
must_haves.why: A small stone cottage is prominently visible near the center-right.

must_haves.item: A stream runs beside the cottage.
must_haves.why: A clearly visible stream flows across the foreground immediately beside the cottage grounds.

must_haves.item: Soft green hills appear behind the cottage.
must_haves.why: Rolling green hills fill the background behind the cottage.

must_haves.item: The composition is square and contains no text.
must_haves.why: The image is square, and no text is visible.

title: Make My Photo Look Professional
tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.

judge.summary: The edit delivers a polished, realistic professional portrait with the man's recognizable features preserved, smart clothing, and a neutral backdrop.

must_haves.item: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
must_haves.why: His short grey hair, eyes, nose, facial contours, and grey stubble remain recognizable.

must_haves.item: His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
must_haves.why: He now wears a white collared shirt and a dark blazer.

must_haves.item: The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
must_haves.why: The kitchen is fully replaced by a plain, softly shaded grey background.

must_haves.item: Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
must_haves.why: Facial highlights are more controlled, with natural-looking directional lighting and visible wrinkles, skin texture, and stubble.

must_haves.item: The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.
must_haves.why: The framing is clean, and the hair edges, clothing, and face show no obvious editing artifacts.

title: Choose The Right Headshot Subject
tests: Clarifies the intended person in a two-person source before producing a single identity-preserving headshot.

checks.name: asks first (Which person in the photo is the user: the bearded man on the left or the short-haired blonde woman on the right?)

got.question: Which person should the headshot feature—the person on the left or the person on the right?

judge.summary: The result is a polished square professional headshot that preserves the woman's recognizable appearance and smile without visible editing artifacts.

must_haves.item: The only person in the final portrait is the short-haired blonde woman from the right of two-friends.jpg.
must_haves.why: The portrait features only the blonde woman selected by the user.

must_haves.item: Her face, short blonde hairstyle and smile remain recognisable from the source.
must_haves.why: Her facial features, side-parted blonde bob, dimples and smiling expression remain recognizable.

must_haves.item: The man is entirely absent, including any partial face, shoulder or arm.
must_haves.why: No part of the man remains visible.

must_haves.item: The beach setting and casual presentation are replaced with professional clothing and an unobtrusive backdrop.
must_haves.why: She wears a dark tailored blazer against a subdued neutral backdrop, with no beach elements remaining.

must_haves.item: The output is a square head-and-shoulders portrait with natural-looking lighting and no visible editing artifacts.
must_haves.why: The square composition frames her head and shoulders with soft, natural-looking light and clean hair, face and clothing boundaries.

title: Transparent Moon Bakery Logo
tests: Delivers a new logo with genuine background transparency rather than a white or painted-checkerboard background.

faults.what: The logo appears on a full off-white square background rather than the requested transparent surrounding area, leaving a visible box for placement on colored backgrounds.

judge.summary: The square logo has the correct navy name and gold crescent, but the visible off-white background fails the transparent-background requirement.

must_haves.item: The name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy lettering.
must_haves.why: Mooncrumb is spelled correctly and clearly rendered in dark navy.

must_haves.item: A gold crescent moon is positioned above the name.
must_haves.why: A gold crescent is centered above the lettering.

must_haves.item: When viewed over different colored backgrounds, the surrounding area is transparent with no opaque rectangle or baked-in checkerboard.
must_haves.why: The supplied image shows a slightly uneven off-white background filling the square canvas rather than transparent surroundings.

must_haves.item: The moon and letter edges remain intact, without conspicuous white halos or missing strokes.
must_haves.why: The lettering and crescent are intact, with no conspicuous white halos or missing strokes; the crescent has a soft gold glow.

title: Three Distinct Cycling Logo Options
tests: Produces exactly three separately usable logo variations with distinct concepts and consistent required wording.

faults.what: The second option has no visible symbol; it is only the club name.
The requested green-and-black palette is not applied to each logo: the first two appear black only, while the third uses green without a clearly visible black element.

judge.summary: Three separate, legible logo options were delivered, but the second lacks a symbol and none clearly combines the requested green and black.

must_haves.item: Exactly three separate square logo images are delivered.
must_haves.why: There are three separate square images, not a collage.

must_haves.item: Each logo clearly reads 'Moss & Mile', including the ampersand.
must_haves.why: All three names are clearly readable and correctly spelled, with an ampersand.

must_haves.item: Each option includes a small symbol alongside or above the name.
must_haves.why: The first has a wheel beside the name and the third has a botanical symbol above it, but the second has no symbol.

must_haves.item: The three options have visibly different symbol or layout concepts, rather than only color changes.
must_haves.why: They use a stacked wordmark with a wheel, a bold single-line wordmark, and a serif wordmark with a botanical symbol above.

must_haves.item: All three use green and black on plain white backgrounds without mockup scenes or option labels.
must_haves.why: The backgrounds are plain white with no scenes or labels, but the first two lack green and the third has no clearly visible black.

title: Repaint Only the Car
tests: Tests targeted car recolouring while preserving the original vehicle, lighting and surrounding scene.

faults.what: There are small changes outside the paint edit, including altered foliage and parked-car details in the background.
The rear bumper contour and some trim details differ slightly from the original.

judge.summary: The car is convincingly navy blue with appropriate sunny reflections, but small changes to the background and car details prevent a perfectly isolated paint edit.

must_haves.item: The hatchback's formerly red body paint is navy blue.
must_haves.why: The previously red body panels are now dark navy blue.

must_haves.item: The car retains its original shape, position, windows, tyres, trim and lights.
must_haves.why: The overall car, position, windows, tyres and lights are closely preserved, but the rear bumper contour and some trim details have shifted slightly.

must_haves.item: Paint shading and reflections remain consistent with the original sunny lighting.
must_haves.why: The blue paint retains bright upper highlights, reflected houses along the side and darker shading on the lower panels.

must_haves.item: The street, houses and other areas outside the painted body remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: The setting is closely matched, but foliage and background parked vehicles show small visible changes.

must_haves.item: The original 16:9 composition is preserved without cropping.
must_haves.why: The output preserves the supplied image's framing and proportions, with no apparent cropping; the supplied original itself is not exactly 16:9.

title: Clean Up This Kitchen
tests: Tests conservative interpretation of a vague cleanup request, clearing clutter without inventing a renovation.

judge.summary: The kitchen is convincingly tidied, with loose clutter removed and the original cabinetry, tiles, fixtures, and viewpoint preserved.

must_haves.item: The countertop looks visibly tidier, with loose clutter removed.
must_haves.why: Dishes, containers, cleaning supplies, and other loose items have been cleared from the counters and sinks.

must_haves.item: The original brown wooden cabinets and beige tiles remain, rather than being replaced with renovated finishes.
must_haves.why: The brown wooden cabinets and beige tiled backsplash remain visibly consistent with the source.

must_haves.item: The kitchen layout, fixed fixtures and viewpoint match the source.
must_haves.why: The same counter arrangement, sinks, faucets, cabinetry, and window remain in the same view.

must_haves.item: Cleared counter areas look continuous and natural, without obvious erasure marks or floating object remnants.
must_haves.why: The exposed countertops and cleared sinks look continuous, with no obvious removal artifacts or leftover object fragments.

title: Bottle on a Kitchen Counter
tests: Tests replacing a product photo's setting while preserving the actual product and making its placement believable.

judge.summary: The bottle is faithfully preserved on a light stone counter in a tidy modern kitchen, with clean edges, natural grounding, and no added text.

must_haves.item: The same matte black bottle is recognizable, with its shape and visible details preserved.
must_haves.why: The silhouette, loop cap, lid seams, matte finish, and small details near the base match the original.

must_haves.item: The bottle stands on a light stone kitchen counter rather than the original wooden table.
must_haves.why: The wooden tabletop has been replaced with a pale, speckled stone counter.

must_haves.item: A tidy modern kitchen is visible behind the bottle.
must_haves.why: The background shows uncluttered white cabinetry, a stone backsplash, counters, and kitchen appliances.

must_haves.item: The bottle has clean edges and a believable contact shadow, without appearing to float.
must_haves.why: The bottle has a clean outline and a soft shadow at its base that grounds it on the counter.

must_haves.item: The output is square and has no added text.
must_haves.why: The image is square, and no added text is visible.

title: Car Photo in Black and White
tests: Converts the supplied photo to neutral grayscale without regenerating, rearranging or cropping its contents.

faults.what: The output retains the original approximately 5:3 aspect ratio rather than the benchmark-specified 16:9; this preserves the user's requested uncropped composition.

judge.summary: The image is cleanly converted to neutral black and white without visible changes or cropping, but its original aspect ratio is not 16:9.

must_haves.item: The entire image is neutral black and white, with no red remaining on the car or colour elsewhere.
must_haves.why: The car, street, trees, houses, and sky all appear neutral grayscale.

must_haves.item: The same compact hatchback remains in the same position and has unchanged body details.
must_haves.why: The car's placement, silhouette, wheels, windows, lights, trim, and reflections remain unchanged apart from colour.

must_haves.item: The street and background objects retain their original positions and appearance apart from colour.
must_haves.why: The houses, trees, parked vehicles, poles, road details, and shadows match the original.

must_haves.item: The full original composition is retained without cropping, in 16:9.
must_haves.why: The full original composition is retained without cropping, but both images are approximately 1024 × 614, not 16:9.

title: Square Crop Keeps Whole Sneaker
tests: Tests converting a 16:9 photo to square while preserving the complete subject and its proportions.

faults.what: Large blurred filler bands were added above and below the original photo, introducing an unrequested decorative treatment despite the instruction not to change anything else.

judge.summary: The square image preserves the entire sneaker without distortion, but adds prominent blurred bands above and below the original photo.

must_haves.item: The delivered image is square.
must_haves.why: The output has equal width and height.

must_haves.item: The sneaker is the same white leather sneaker as in the attachment.
must_haves.why: The sneaker's shape, stitching, laces, panels and sole match the source.

must_haves.item: The entire sneaker, including toe, heel and sole, remains visible.
must_haves.why: The complete sneaker is visible with space around the toe, heel and sole.

must_haves.item: The sneaker has natural proportions, without stretching or squeezing.
must_haves.why: The sneaker retains the source image's proportions.

must_haves.item: The retained floor and background match the source photo, with no added text or decorative elements.
must_haves.why: The original floor and background remain intact, but blurred decorative filler bands have been added at the top and bottom.

title: Portrait Photo Into Story Frame
tests: Tests creating a vertical story from a square portrait without clipping the person or distorting the photo.

judge.summary: The portrait fits a 9:16 story frame with all original hair and shoulders preserved, natural proportions, and blurred photo padding above and below.

must_haves.item: The delivered image has a 9:16 vertical frame.
must_haves.why: The output has the required tall 9:16 proportions.

must_haves.item: The sharp foreground portrait shows the same woman, curly hair and sweater as the attachment.
must_haves.why: The sharp central image preserves the same face, curls, and gray knitted sweater.

must_haves.item: No hair or shoulder area visible in the source is lost.
must_haves.why: The full source portrait is retained, including its hair and shoulder boundaries.

must_haves.item: The portrait is not stretched or squeezed.
must_haves.why: The foreground retains the source's proportions without visible distortion.

must_haves.item: Any added background space uses a blurred version of the source photo, with no text.
must_haves.why: The upper and lower padding show a blurred enlarged copy of the portrait, and no text is present.

title: One Car Photo Three Sizes
tests: Tests delivering three distinct aspect-ratio adaptations of one source while keeping the complete subject in every version.

judge.summary: Three separate images in the requested ratios preserve the complete, unchanged car with blurred source-photo padding and no added text.

must_haves.item: Three separate images are delivered, rather than one collage.
must_haves.why: The outputs are three distinct images.

must_haves.item: The three frames have ratios of 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 respectively.
must_haves.why: The displayed outputs have the requested square, portrait feed, and tall story proportions, respectively.

must_haves.item: Every version shows the same red hatchback from the attached photo.
must_haves.why: All three retain the source photo's red hatchback and surrounding street scene.

must_haves.item: The complete car, including roof, wheels and both ends, is visible in every version.
must_haves.why: The roof, visible wheels, front end, and rear bumper remain fully inside each frame.

must_haves.item: The car retains its original proportions and appearance in all versions.
must_haves.why: The sharp source image is preserved without visible stretching, warping, or changes to the car.

must_haves.item: Any padding is a blurred version of the source photo, and no version contains added text.
must_haves.why: Each image uses blurred source-photo imagery above and below the sharp photo, with no added text.

title: Left Edge Sneaker Stays Visible
tests: Tests subject-aware reframing of an off-centre product instead of a default centre crop that loses the subject.

faults.what: The added top and bottom padding contains enlarged, blurred duplicates of the shoe and background clutter rather than plain matching background. Visible transitions and ghosted shapes make the padding distracting and introduce an unrequested decorative treatment.

judge.summary: The square output preserves the complete original sneaker, but uses distracting blurred-image padding instead of plain matching background.

must_haves.item: The delivered image is square.
must_haves.why: The output has equal width and height.

must_haves.item: The output includes the original left-side sneaker, not an empty crop of the middle of the source.
must_haves.why: The original left-side sneaker is clearly present.

must_haves.item: The complete sneaker remains visible, including toe, heel and sole.
must_haves.why: The toe, heel, upper and full sole remain within the image.

must_haves.item: The sneaker's proportions, colour and details match the source.
must_haves.why: The main sneaker retains its original shape, white colour, stitching and lace details.

must_haves.item: Any added padding blends with the source background, with no text or decorative additions.
must_haves.why: Although there is no added text, the padding repeats enlarged, blurred image content, including the shoe, and does not blend unobtrusively with the original background.

title: Which Friend Gets My Face
tests: Tests clarification of an ambiguous target face and preservation of the unselected person.

checks.name: asks first (Which person in two-friends.jpg should receive the user's face: the bearded man on the left or the blonde woman on the right?)

got.question: Which person in the beach photo should receive your face—the person on the left or the person on the right?

faults.what: The bearded man's face was also replaced or substantially altered: his eyes, eyebrows, nose, cheeks, and smile differ visibly from the original, despite explicit instructions to leave him alone.

judge.summary: The woman's face is plausibly swapped and blended, but the man's face is also visibly changed, violating the central instruction.

must_haves.item: Only the woman on the right receives the face from portrait-woman.jpg.
must_haves.why: Both faces show altered facial features; the edit is not limited to the woman.

must_haves.item: The bearded man's face on the left remains unchanged.
must_haves.why: His facial features and expression are visibly different from the original beach photo.

must_haves.item: The replaced face is recognizable and blended to match the beach lighting and head angle.
must_haves.why: The woman's edited eyes, eyebrows, and nose resemble the portrait, with a convincing head angle and sunlit shading.

must_haves.item: The original bodies, clothing, beach background and wide framing remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: The visible bodies, clothing, hair, beach scenery, and framing match the original.

must_haves.item: No text is added.
must_haves.why: No text is visible.

title: Invent A Courier Then Reuse
tests: Creates a character from words, then preserves its generated design and visual style in two follow-up scenes.

faults.what: The cottage picture contains no visible parcel or delivery action; the robot is simply standing at the closed door holding her mailbag.
Both pictures add a glossy black eye-like oval beside the amber eye, making the robot appear to have two eyes rather than the requested single eye.

judge.summary: Two polished, visually consistent square pictures depict the requested settings, but the cottage scene lacks a parcel delivery and both robots have an additional eye-like feature.

must_haves.item: The initial square illustration shows the robot courier at a recognisable train station.
must_haves.why: The initial train-station illustration is not supplied.

must_haves.item: The robot has a round teal body, exactly one large amber eye, short red boots and a yellow mailbag in all three images.
must_haves.why: Both supplied pictures show the teal body, large amber eye, red boots and yellow bag, but also an additional glossy black eye-like oval. The initial image cannot be checked.

must_haves.item: The two follow-up images preserve the first robot's specific shape, proportions and design details rather than redesigning her.
must_haves.why: The two visible robots closely match each other, but the initial robot is unavailable for comparison.

must_haves.item: One follow-up shows her delivering a parcel at a cottage door; the other shows her sheltering beneath a giant mushroom with rain visible around it.
must_haves.why: The mushroom scene clearly shows shelter beneath a giant mushroom with visible rain. The cottage scene shows a suitable doorway but no parcel or delivery action.

must_haves.item: Three separate square pictures share a consistent storybook illustration style and contain no text.
must_haves.why: The two supplied pictures are separate, square, text-free and stylistically consistent, with a detailed storybook-like rendered appearance. The third, initial picture is not available.

title: Silent Clip Subtitle Check
tests: Tests recognizing absent speech and reporting it instead of fabricating subtitles from visible mouth movements or a related source.

must_haves.item: The response clearly states that the supplied clip has no audible speech to transcribe.
must_haves.why: The agent only promises to check; it never states that the clip has no audible speech, and the recorded check failed.

must_haves.item: No dialogue is inferred from the woman's mouth movements or borrowed from another clip.
must_haves.why: No inferred or borrowed dialogue appears in the transcript.

must_haves.item: No subtitled video, fabricated transcript, or replacement voice is presented.
must_haves.why: Captions were proposed, but no subtitled video, fabricated transcript, or replacement voice was presented.

must_haves.item: The response does not claim the silent file contains recognizable spoken words.
must_haves.why: The agent discusses speech conditionally and never claims that recognizable words are present.

reply.summary: The agent meets three must-haves but fails to clearly report that the clip has no audible speech.

title: Five Tips Five Separate Slides
tests: Tests one-to-one mapping of five supplied tips to five ordered slides without adding cover or closing slides.

faults.what: All five requested tips are absent; instruction-like placeholder text appears instead.
None of the slides displays its required number from 1 through 5.
The requested blue-and-white palette is missing; the slides use black or gray marks on white.
Slide 1 contains five repeated desk illustrations separated by horizontal lines, unlike the single-illustration layouts on the other slides.
Illustration scale and headline placement vary substantially, with very faint, tiny artwork on slides 1 and 3.

judge.summary: Five portrait slides were delivered with relevant illustrations, but every tip and slide number is missing and the requested blue-and-white design was not followed.

must_haves.item: Exactly five separate 4:5 portrait images are delivered, with no extra cover or closing slide.
must_haves.why: There are five separate 4:5 portrait images and no additional cover or closing image.

must_haves.item: The five supplied tips appear verbatim, one per slide, in the requested order.
must_haves.why: None of the supplied tips appears; each slide instead contains 'at the top' or a longer placeholder variation.

must_haves.item: The slides are visibly numbered 1 through 5 in sequence.
must_haves.why: No slide numbers are visible.

must_haves.item: Each slide has an illustration relevant to its specific tip.
must_haves.why: The slides respectively show desks, a notification bell, a checklist, a timer, and a person stretching.

must_haves.item: All slides share a clean blue-and-white visual design with readable, unclipped text.
must_haves.why: The visible text is unclipped, but the artwork and lettering are black or gray rather than blue, and layouts are inconsistent.

title: One Print Style Across Plants
tests: Tests preservation of a tightly specified visual style and repeated layout across distinct carousel subjects.

faults.what: The plants are rendered as naturalistic cutouts rather than the requested sage-green-and-cream linocut illustrations.
All four slides lack the requested border, paper texture, and pot.

The repeated design changes: Monstera has a gray-cream background while the others are near-white, Snake plant uses lighter-weight lettering, and label positions and plant placement vary substantially.
Pothos is shown as a compact cluster of leaves without the required trailing vines.

judge.summary: Four correctly named square slides were delivered in order, but they omit the requested linocut design system and fail the consistent-layout requirement.

must_haves.item: There are four separate square slides with the exact plant names in the requested order.
must_haves.why: The four square images read Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, and Peace lily in that order.

must_haves.item: The plants are distinguishable: split monstera leaves, upright snake-plant leaves, trailing pothos vines, and a peace lily with a white spathe.
must_haves.why: Monstera has split foliage, Snake plant has upright leaves, and Peace lily has white spathes, but Pothos lacks trailing vines.

must_haves.item: All four illustrations use the same sage-green-and-cream linocut treatment rather than mixing visual styles.
must_haves.why: The images use naturalistic green foliage with shading and yellow variegation, not a sage-and-cream linocut treatment.

must_haves.item: Border design, lettering treatment, paper texture and pot shape remain consistent across all four slides.
must_haves.why: Borders, pots, and visible paper texture are absent, and the Snake plant lettering is noticeably lighter than the other labels.

must_haves.item: Only the plant and its name visibly change; the repeated layout stays aligned and all names are readable.
must_haves.why: All names are readable, but background color, lettering weight, plant placement, and label height change between slides.

title: Kitchen Renovation Side by Side
tests: Composes two supplied photos into one correctly ordered, clearly labeled comparison without regenerating either scene.

faults.what: The renovated kitchen on the right is missing the required “After” label.

judge.summary: The photos are neatly preserved side by side in a 16:9 image, but the required “After” label is missing.

must_haves.item: One finished 16:9 image contains both supplied kitchen photos side by side.
must_haves.why: The landscape output is 16:9 and contains both photos side by side.

must_haves.item: The brown-cabinet kitchen is on the left and the white-cabinet renovated kitchen is on the right.
must_haves.why: Both kitchens appear in the requested positions.

must_haves.item: The left panel is labeled exactly 'Before' and the right panel exactly 'After', with readable, unclipped text.
must_haves.why: “Before” is readable and unclipped above the left panel, but “After” is absent.

must_haves.item: Both complete photos remain visible without stretching or changes to their contents.
must_haves.why: Both photos appear complete, proportionally scaled, and unchanged in content.

title: Imagine My Kitchen Renovation
tests: Generates a source-faithful renovation from one photo and combines it with the untouched original in a labeled comparison.

faults.what: The makeover removes the original right-hand sink and faucet, replacing them with countertop instead of preserving major fixture positions.
The renovated backsplash has a square tile grid rather than the requested white subway tiles.
Both labels appear together as “Before, After” above the left panel, leaving the right panel without its own correctly positioned “After” label.

judge.summary: The image provides a clean side-by-side renovation comparison, but removes a sink, uses the wrong backsplash tile pattern, and groups both labels above the original photo.

must_haves.item: One finished 16:9 image shows the supplied original kitchen on the left and a visibly renovated version on the right.
must_haves.why: The finished image is 16:9 and places the original kitchen on the left and a visibly renovated kitchen on the right.

must_haves.item: The left photo retains its brown cabinets, beige tiles and original clutter.
must_haves.why: The original brown cabinetry, beige backsplash, dishes, containers and other countertop clutter remain visible.

must_haves.item: The right panel has white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles and uncluttered counters.
must_haves.why: White shaker-style cabinets, light wood counters and clear surfaces are present, but the backsplash uses square tiles rather than subway tiles.

must_haves.item: The generated kitchen preserves the original room geometry, major fixture positions and camera viewpoint rather than showing a different kitchen.
must_haves.why: The U-shaped layout, window, rear sink and general viewpoint are recognizable, but the right-hand sink and faucet have been removed.

must_haves.item: Readable labels say exactly 'Before' above or within the left panel and 'After' above or within the right panel.
must_haves.why: Both words are readable, but they are combined above the left panel rather than individually labeling the corresponding panels.

title: Readable Sale Copy Every Size
tests: Preserves complete, readable ad copy and visual hierarchy when adapting one design to three substantially different canvas shapes.

exact_text.read_as: Fern House in all three variants; split across two lines in the portrait.
Weekend Plant Sale in all three variants; split across two lines in the portrait.
Square and landscape: “20% off all indoor plants”. Portrait: “20% off all indo[overlapping, malformed letters]” followed by “plants”.
Square and landscape: “Saturday & Sunday”. Portrait appears to read “Saturday &Junday”, with the first letter of Sunday malformed and crowded against the ampersand.
Visit 24 Willow Lane in all three variants; the portrait places “Visit” on its own line.

faults.what: The portrait has overlapping, malformed letters at the end of “indoor” and a malformed start to “Sunday”, so its required promotional copy is not cleanly reproduced.

The square does not match the other two as a clean green-and-cream campaign: it uses white text over a busy full-bleed plant photograph, while the portrait and landscape use dark text on a pale panel framed by foliage.

judge.summary: The three correctly proportioned ads have prominent addresses, but garbled portrait copy and a substantially different square treatment prevent a polished matching set.

must_haves.item: All five specified text strings appear correctly and completely in every variant.

must_haves.why: All three addresses are large and readable, but the portrait's malformed offer and day text prevent comfortable reading of every line.

must_haves.item: No text is clipped, pushed against the canvas edge or distorted to fit.

must_haves.why: The layouts adapt to each shape and all include foliage, but the square's full-photo background and white typography depart substantially from the pale-background styling of the other two.

title: Bottle Listing From One Photo
tests: Tests turning one attached product photo into three finished listing images while preserving the source product's identity.

faults.what: The enlarged close-up is somewhat soft, limiting the fine detail visible in the lid and matte surface.

must_haves.why: The outputs are three individual square images.

title: Monday Meme From Scratch
tests: Tests turning a vague topic into one finished visual meme by choosing the imagery, joke, and readable text without unnecessary clarification.

judge.summary: A finished, clearly legible Monday meme pairs a sleepy cat beside a coffee mug with a relatable joke about failed fresh-start ambitions.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is a finished meme image, not just a suggested caption or description.
must_haves.why: The image includes a complete visual and top-and-bottom meme captions.

must_haves.item: The caption explicitly references Monday or Mondays.

must_haves.item: All caption text is legible, fully inside the image, and contrasts with its background.
must_haves.why: Both captions are fully within the frame and use large white letters with thick black outlines.

must_haves.item: The visual supports the caption's joke or reaction.
must_haves.why: The cat resting its head on the table beside a coffee mug clearly conveys Monday fatigue.
